Yellowstone becomes the world's first national park.
Concorde makes its first flight.
Alexander Graham Bell is born in Edinburgh.
The US Constitution takes effect.
Churchill warns of an "iron curtain" across Europe.
Dmitri Mendeleev presents his periodic table.
Alexander Graham Bell is granted a patent for the telephone.
A women's march in Petrograd sparks the Russian Revolution.
Barbie makes her debut at the New York Toy Fair.
Bell makes the first phone call: "Mr. Watson, come here."
The Daily Courant, England's first daily newspaper, appears.
Tim Berners-Lee proposes the system that becomes the Web.
William Herschel discovers Uranus.
Albert Einstein is born in Ulm.
symbolics.com becomes the first registered .com domain.
Robert Goddard launches the first liquid-fuelled rocket.
Vanguard 1 launches; it is still in orbit today.
Alexei Leonov makes the first spacewalk.
The Sydney Harbour Bridge opens.
Uncle Tom's Cabin is published.
Jack Dorsey sends the first tweet.
Intel ships the first Pentium processor.
The first passenger elevator by Elisha Otis goes into service.
Robert Koch announces he has found the cause of tuberculosis.
Christiaan Huygens discovers Titan.
Jonas Salk announces a successful polio vaccine.
Marconi sends the first wireless message across the English Channel.
Constantinople is officially renamed Istanbul.
Farmers digging a well discover the Terracotta Army.
The US agrees to buy Alaska from Russia.
The Eiffel Tower is inaugurated.
